title: Beetroot Seeds
intro: Seeds needed to grow Beetroot.

title: Blossomveil Seeds
intro: Seeds needed to grow Blossomveil in your garden.

title: Cotton Seeds
intro: Seeds needed to grow Cotton.

title: Deer
intro: Neutral wildlife that can be hunted. A graceful prize of the forest, whispering tales of silent strength. There are two variations: the **Doe** and the **Stag** [1], [2].

title: Farm
intro: A space to grown various plants with the help of a hoe, water and fertilizer.

title: Fertilizer
intro: Fertilizer is a farming resource used to improve crop growth (and is commonly produced from peat + water or composted burnt/spoiled food).<ref name="bw-fertilizer">https://bellwright.fandom.com/wiki/Fertilizer</ref>

title: Flax Seeds
intro: Seeds needed to grow Flax.

title: Foraging Camp
intro: Harvests plants in the area around it using Workforce. Best place near lush areas.

title: Foraging Hut
intro: Two workers can simultaneously harvest various plants and resources, increasing efficiency, while drying edibles like mushrooms and berries on forger racks.

title: Foraging Lodge
intro: This upgrade from the Foraging Hut allow more workers to be assigned to it, has a larger storage capacity, extends the harvesting radius, and includes racks to dry various edibles like mushrooms and berries.

title: Forester
intro: Grows saplings from tree seeds to replenish forest areas.

title: Garden
intro: Used to grow various decorative flowers.

title: Garlic Seeds
intro: Seeds needed to grow Garlic.

title: Harvesting

fields.name: Harvesting
fields.description: Collecting plants and raw resources. For [Villagers], Harvesting work is controlled by [Job Priorities] and improved by the [Attributes#Harvesting|Harvesting] attribute.

intro: Harvesting covers gathering plants and raw resources from the world. This includes hand-collecting items such as berries, mushrooms, and other plants, as well as using harvesting structures (foraging, logging, mining, and some farm/outpost buildings) that gather resources using workers.

title: Hemp Seeds
intro: Seeds needed to grow Hemp

title: Logging Camp
intro: One worker can use this to cut down trees in a small area. Best to place near a dense forest.

title: Lumberjack
intro: This upgrade from the logging camp expands storage space, allows more workers to be assigned to it, and lets them cut down trees within an increased radius.

title: Mining Camp
intro: One worker can use this to mine metal ores and stones in a small area, as well as process larger rocks into smaller chunks. For the best results, place near a metal vein.

title: Mining Hut
intro: This upgrade from the mining camp allows both Iron Ore and Granite to be mined, more workers to be assigned to it, has a larger storage space, and mines within an increased radius.

title: Mud Collector
intro: Used for collecting mud with a shovel.

title: Onion Seeds
intro: Seeds needed to grow Onion.

title: Orchard
intro: The Orchard is a building that lets you grow various trees.

title: Pit
intro: This upgrade from the Mining Hut requires placement near mineable nodes. Your workers can operate both at depots above ground and underground, with underground depots depleting resources more slowly.

title: Potato Seeds
intro: Seeds needed to grow Potato.

title: Radish Seeds
intro: Seeds needed to grow Radish.

title: Sage Seeds
intro: Seeds needed to grow Sage.

title: Snowpetal Seeds
intro: Seeds needed to grow Snowpetal in your garden.

title: Spoiled Food
intro: Left over organic matter from spoiling food.

title: Sunflower Seeds
intro: Seeds needed to grow Sunflower in your garden.

title: Sunleaf Seeds
intro: Seeds needed to grow Sunleaf in your garden.

title: Tree Sapling
intro: A growing tree, ready to be planted in a forest by your worker.

title: Tree Seeds
intro: Seeds needed to grow Trees.

title: Turnip Seeds
intro: Seeds needed to grow Turnip.

title: Woodcutting

fields.name: Woodcutting
fields.related: Harvesting, Resources, Tools, Logging Camp, Lumberjack, Lumbermill, Forester, Crafting, Strength

intro: Woodcutting is the set of actions and settlement jobs used to gather wood resources (Wood, Log, and Hardwood Log) and process them into common building materials like Wooden Plank and Hardwood Plank. It can be done manually with an axe or automated through harvesting and crafting structures.
